subject: Proposed co-sell runbook & staggered demo windows for Acme Financial marketplace launch
messages:
From: Sara Hill <sara.hill@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eric Li <eric.li@orchardsi.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, May 6, 2027 at 16:12 -0700
Subject: Proposed co-sell runbook & demo windows for Acme Financial marketplace launch

Hi Vanessa and team,

Thanks for coordinating on the Acme Financial marketplace listing. Acme is excited to see a live walk-through of the marketplace integration and a short SI technical run through. To keep the execs and procurement teams happy, we recommend two short, focused sessions rather than one long call: a customer-facing product demo (25 mins) + Q&A (10 mins), then a separate SI deep-dive (30 mins) for onboarding/ops.

Proposed staggered windows next week (PT / ET):
- Option A: Tue 2027-05-12 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET — product demo
- Option B: Tue 2027-05-12 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET — product demo (alternate)
- SI deep-dive: Wed 2027-05-13 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET (or we can run immediately after Option B)

Attendees we expect: Tom Reynolds (Acme, procurement), their engineering lead (TBD), AWS GTM manager, Redwood product + solutions (Vanessa, Karthik), Orchard SI tech owner (Eric). Could you confirm availability for the two product-demo slots and whether Redwood prefers Option A or B? Also attaching a first-pass runbook and the co-sell slide deck so we can align on talking points.

Attachments: Redwood_CoSell_Slides_v1.pptx, Runbook_Rehearsal_Notes.docx

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Hill
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
Amazon Web Services
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hill <sara.hill@amazon.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Eric Li <eric.li@orchardsi.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, May 6, 2027 at 18:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed co-sell runbook & demo windows for Acme Financial marketplace launch

Thanks Sara — this looks great. Quick notes from Redwood:
- We have a calendar conflict for Tue 05/12 09:00 PT (Tom's calendar shows a standing all-hands). Can we shift the first product-demo slot to 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET instead? That keeps the late-morning window for the Acme execs.
- We agree on splitting product demo + SI deep dive. For the product demo we'll aim for a 25/10 split and record the session for AWS co-sell approval. Please confirm Acme is OK with recording.
- Would like to rehearse with Orchard SI and Redwood tech 1 business day before; propose Mon 05/11 11:00 PT (short 30-min run).

Small ask: Karthik, can you lead the product demo intro and I’ll handle the marketplace onboarding bits? Sergio, could you confirm we have the approvals to record and share with AWS?

Date: Fri, May 7, 2027 at 09:45 -04:00
Subject: Re: Proposed co-sell runbook & demo windows for Acme Financial marketplace launch

Vanessa — thanks, we can make the 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET slot work. A couple of operational asks from Orchard SI:
- Please include procurement/marketplace onboarding lead from Acme on the product-demo invite (we need to collect the marketplace contract metadata during the call).
- I can lead the SI deep-dive on Wed 05/13; I’ll focus on onboarding checklist items and required artifacts (SSL certs, service account scopes, audit log expectations). See attached test plan.

Attachment: Orchard_SI_Testplan.xlsx

If recording is required for the co-sell packet, confirm what subset of the recording is OK to share (slides + demo, or full session incl Q&A?).

—Eric

Principal Solutions Architect, Orchard Systems Integrations

Operational note for Redwood ops: when we send invites, add a short bullet in the calendar description about what will be recorded and where the recording link will be stored (Drive folder). Also include the marketplace questionnaire link for procurement.

- Product demo (alternate): Tue 2027-05-12 14:00 PT / 17:00 ET — fallback if any attendee conflicts
- SI deep-dive: Wed 2027-05-13 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET — Orchard to lead onboarding checklist items
